audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read "Skill" while win[0..6] reads Brand, Brand, Galio, Galio, Galio, Brand, Galio.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches win[] exactly; the full layer was stale, so the page answered 'who wins Level 1' two different ways.
audit.corrected: Sides set to match win[] row for row; the two Brand early rows and the Brand first-item row also had Galio-favoured whys, which are rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0], [1] and [5] described Galio winning stages the chart awards to Brand.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame is 900 range on a 10s cooldown against Galio's 825-range Q and 18s W, so levels 1-2 are his; at first item Sear (6-8s) stunning an ablaze target chains into a 100s Pyroclasm.
audit.corrected: All three whys rewritten to Brand's side with real ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributed Brand's stun to Conflagration (E) in whys[5], late and wants.foe[1]. Brand's stun is Sear (Q), and only against a target already ablaze. wants.you[0] called Pillar of Flame his Q. breakdown.cooldowns held no number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Kit: Q Sear stuns only if the target is ablaze; W Pillar of Flame is the ground AoE; E Conflagration is a targeted spread with no CC. Blaze burns for 4 seconds and detonates at three stacks.
audit.corrected: Stun re-attributed to Sear everywhere, Pillar of Flame relabelled W, and cooldowns now carries Sear 8/6s, Conflagration 13s and Pyroclasm 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions claims Pillar of Flame can deny Justice Punch (dash-denied).
audit.why: Riot's text for Pillar of Flame is a delayed area damage zone with no grounding or wall; the 'terrain' flag looks like a tooltip-parsing misfire. Not asserted anywhere in the proposal.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Check it before every step-up. - W Shield of Durand is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Sear (Q): 8s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5, and it only stuns when Blaze is already on you — step up clean and it is just damage. - Pyroclasm: 100s at rank 1. - Conflagration is 13s at rank 1 and needs no skillshot, so it is the chip you cannot dodge.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Sear is 8s at rank 1 — the moment it misses, E in and Q, because without a stun he cannot stop the taunt that follows.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Brand's Blaze keeps ticking for 4 seconds after his last spell, so a chase you win on paper ends with you dying to burn.

edits.before: Brand burns Sear (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Brand burns Sear on a minion — that is a 6-to-8 second window to walk in.

edits.before: That’s Brand’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: With W down, Blaze stacks to three and detonates on you two seconds later.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze on you, stunning with Sear when you step in, and bouncing Pyroclasm off your dive.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by punishing his stand-still: Hero's Entrance knocks him up from 4000 range and taunt keeps him off his own team.

edits.before: Q the wave contacts — the windblast's tornado tick chunks mages who stand in it for the full duration.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame is 900 range on a 10s cooldown and outranges your 825 Q, so level 1 chip is free for him.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: anyone who steps to punish your Q eats a taunt audition.
edits.after: Blaze stacks off every spell, so his chip compounds while your W is an 18s answer.

edits.before: First item spike: the full taunt rotation chunks and your MR makes AP trades a subscription you sell.
edits.after: First item: Sear stuns you once Blaze is on, and that stun feeds Pyroclasm's five bounces off a 100s ult.

edits.before: Brand's stun-into-Pyroclasm combo becomes a real threat once he can land Conflagration on your engage.
edits.after: Brand's stun-into-Pyroclasm combo becomes a real threat once Blaze is on you and Sear can stun your engage.

edits.before: In the late game your engage becomes a liability against his kit — if he lands Conflagration's stun on your dive, Pyroclasm chains for a huge burst onto whoever you jumped in on, so you must strip vision on his flash/stun before going in and target him first if possible.
edits.after: In the late game your engage becomes a liability against his kit — Conflagration lights Blaze on your whole dive and Sear stuns whoever is ablaze, then Pyroclasm bounces five times off the clump, so bait Sear first, R onto him rather than past him, and kill him early in the fight.

edits.before: Save Conflagration stun for your E engage window
edits.after: Save the Sear stun for your E engage window

edits.before: Play around minion waves to block his Q Pillar poke lines
edits.after: Dodge the W Pillar of Flame zone instead of hiding in the wave

edits.before: Once you hit 3 items of levels and can weave Q Winds of War with E Justice Punch, you close the gap on Brand fast enough that his Pillar of Flame poke stops being free, and you start winning the CS-and-trade war.
edits.after: Once you have all three of Q Winds of War, W Shield of Durand and E Justice Punch, you close the gap fast enough that his 10-second Pillar of Flame poke stops being free, and you start winning the CS-and-trade war.

notes: Same full-layer chart staleness as azir: all seven phases[N].side were 'Skill' while win[] already carried the packet chart, so only side edits are proposed (win[] is already correct and a no-op pair would be rejected). Real fabrication fixed: three content fields attributed Brand's stun to Conflagration (E) — it is Sear (Q), and only versus an ablaze target. missingInteractions claims Pillar of Flame denies Justice Punch; Riot's W text has no grounding or wall, so I treated the 'terrain' flag as a parsing misfire and did not write it. dosFull[1].t ('E-Q the cooldown silence after') mentions a silence Brand does not have, but is a title I left alone; flagging it here.
